stem.text: A loudspeaker emits sound of frequency $f_\text{s}$. The loudspeaker is attached to a car that moves with increasing speed directly towards a stationary observer.
Which statement describes the frequency of the sound heard by the observer?

A.text: a frequency greater than $f_\text{s}$ and increasing

B.text: a frequency greater than $f_\text{s}$ but decreasing

C.text: a frequency less than $f_\text{s}$ and decreasing

D.text: a frequency less than $f_\text{s}$ but increasing
